description: Pigs, cows and chickens roll a random sound variant in finalizeSpawn from the level random; execute with an nbt selector marks each mob's sound_variant with a block, data merge sets a new one (an unknown key keeps the old) and the marks are set again.

actions.command: execute as @e[type=minecraft:pig,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:big"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:gold_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:pig,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:classic"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:iron_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:pig,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:mini"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:diamond_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:cow,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:classic"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:iron_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:cow,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:moody"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:emerald_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:chicken,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:classic"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:iron_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:chicken,nbt={sound_variant:"minecraft:picky"}] at @s run setblock ~ -58 ~ minecraft:lapis_block
execute as @e[type=minecraft:pig] run data merge entity @s {sound_variant:"minecraft:mini"}
